Junko Kirihara is a Taimanin that works as a negotiator in the UFS under Gosha Village orders.

That's right. Other students often ask me for advice. What's the content? Hehe, of course it's a secret ♪
Kirihara Junko



Personality
She is trusted among the Taimanin because of her softness and politeness. In particular, she is a reliable older sister to the students of Gosha Academy, and is sometimes asked for advice on matters other than her duties.

On top of that, she's a team player, and she's trying to make her unit look good.

Appearance
She has white long hair in a ponytail and yellow almost amber colored eyes. She wears a yellow and black mecha like armor. Junko appears as a big chested woman.

History
Background
Junko is a trained Taimanin of Gosha Academy. She works overseas, to improve the work with other nations.

The ostensible purpose of her dispatch to the UFS is to strengthen the forces against the demon tribe and the Chinese Union. However, in reality, the purpose is more of a political one, in order to build a smooth relationship with the UFS. She was judged to be the best person for the job because of her high negotiation skills as well as her combat ability.

In battle, she was a good match for the equipment of the Federation, as she was a master of the art of thunderclap. In addition, she is a team player and tries to make a good impression on her troops, so even the soldiers of the U.S. Federation, who were initially wary of the Taimanin, have come to trust her.

Junko is aware of their political intentions, but she is not too happy with their strategy of deceiving the soldiers in the field.

Timeline RPGX
Appeared during an event, in which a fusion of Simurgh/Orobas which Fürst created was fought and defeated, with the help of the Beast Kingdom. She appeared again, this time tasked to hunt after the Enbarr. A horse demon, which had been captured by Fürst and escaped after his death. Assisted by Sally Roberts and Akiyama Rinko.

Junko was also called for the Yomihara Summer Festival, year 2088, in which she assists Kotaro in the protection of Kousaka Shizuru, which the Black Bunny tried to kill. Junko can be contacted last minute by Shizuru and is able to force the Black Bunny to flee with her strong Lightning Art. In year 2089, assigned as the vice captain of the Hound Dogz under Yatsu Murasaki in Amidahara assists the Independent Commando Unit and Mirabell Bell in the destruction of the AQ-9 Killer Bee.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Sword

Ninja Art: "Lightning Art", "Thunderclap" lightning ability.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.
